_comment: Job sources for ingestion. Every endpoint here was verified live on 2026-08-12 — see docs/decisions/0004-job-source-selection.md. Greenhouse board tokens are not guessable; several plausible ones 404.
_keywords_comment: Multi-word phrases on purpose. A bare 'infrastructure' or 'cloud' matches sales and data-centre-operations roles; measured on the cloudflare board, a loose pattern hit 43/305 including 'GTM Specialist' and 'Customer Engineer'. Precision over recall: a dashboard full of false positives is one you stop reading.
